script: Did you know Jimmy Butler got dreadlock extensions in the 2022 off-season just to troll the NBA? He rocked them all summer, then chopped them off right after NBA Media Day. That's because Media Day is when the NBA snaps the players' pictures they use for the whole season. So Jimmy basically tricked the NBA into using the dreadlock photo even though he didn't have them anymore. And it didn't stop there. When ESPN showed the All-Star frontcourt votes, every player had a normal headshot except Jimmy. They had enough and just used his NBA 2K face instead.
